title: Two-node OCI deployment contract
summary: For two Oracle Cloud nodes, prefer the private VCN path and enforce peer restriction twice: OCI network admission permits only the reciprocal peer IPv4 /32 on the Queue Fabric TCP port, and Queue Fabric trustPeer binds the same exact numeric private IPv4 at the application layer.
invariants: Prefer private VCN addresses; do not route Queue Fabric over the public internet when private connectivity is available.
At OCI, express one allowed IPv4 as an exact /32 ingress source for the Queue Fabric port.
Inside Queue Fabric, supply the exact address without CIDR notation because the application allowlist is exact-IP, not a network parser.
Do not expose the Queue Fabric port as 0.0.0.0/0.
If both nodes accept inbound Queue Fabric sessions, apply reciprocal rules; distinct A->B and B->A PSKs/key IDs reduce blast radius.

provenance.claim: Private VCN and reciprocal exact /32 OCI admission pattern.
Application trustPeer/registerEndpoint examples, exact IP rule, crypto admission and separate directional key recommendation.
OCI deployment rule states network /32 plus application exact-IP enforcement and forbids 0.0.0.0/0.
